sub_sector.value: Agricultural irrigation systems; roadway safety and traffic management

manufacturing_type.detail: Manufactures individual products and assembled systems, including Zimmatic pivots, crash cushions and roadway barriers.

product_complexity.detail: Engineered irrigation and roadway systems incorporate FieldNET water management, intelligent traffic management and remote asset monitoring.

production_role.detail: Manufactures finished irrigation and roadway equipment and reaches customers through irrigation dealers and infrastructure sales representatives.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves growers, roadway operators and highway construction projects, and provides industrial technology.

notes: The evidence leaves the mix of order-based and stock production unclear.
